title: Tremont Tavern
venue_description:
Tremont Tavern: Chattanooga's Legendary Music Venue and Pub

Established in 2006 Tremont Tavern has become an institution in Chattanooga's music and food scene. Located on the North Shore the venue perfectly balances its role as a full-service restaurant and pub with its commitment to fostering live music and the local creative community.

Music Venue Excellence

The venue's open mic nights have given countless Chattanooga musicians their start providing an accessible stage for local talent. The intimate setting with its modest stage area creates a perfect environment for acoustic performances singer-songwriters and small ensembles. Regular weekend live music performances feature touring bands and established local acts ensuring a consistent calendar of quality entertainment.

The Food Experience

Tremont Tavern has earned recognition as one of Chattanooga's best burger destinations. Using a proprietary grind and beef blend the kitchen creates mouth-watering burgers that keep patrons returning regularly. The menu extends beyond burgers with quality pub fare available throughout the day. The draft selection features carefully chosen local and regional craft beers complemented by a solid bottle selection.

Community Gathering Place

What sets Tremont apart is its authentic neighborhood character. Regular customers and visiting musicians alike praise the welcoming atmosphere created by staff and ownership. The venue draws everyone from families with children to late-night musicians and creative types. The eclectic crowd united by appreciation for good food live music and genuine hospitality creates the vibe that makes Chattanooga special.

Practical Details

The venue offers both dine-in and takeout options with reasonable pricing. Parking is available in the surrounding area. The space maintains the authentic dive bar aesthetic that music venues thrive in while providing professional sound and stage equipment for performers.

title: Cherry Street Tavern
venue_description:
Cherry Street Tavern: Downtown Chattanooga's Premier Music Venue

Opened in early 2021 Cherry Street Tavern has rapidly established itself as one of downtown Chattanooga's most important music venues. Located at 719 Cherry Street in the heart of the historic district this British-style pub brings international flair to Chattanooga's live music culture.

Venue Architecture and Acoustics

The space features exceptional sight lines from all areas allowing patrons to see and hear performances regardless of seating position. The intimate capacity around 150 people creates an ideal environment for both emerging and established performers. The acoustics are professional-quality with clear sound throughout the room. High ceilings and thoughtful design allow for both standing-room events and seated performances.

Live Music Programming

Cherry Street hosts multiple recurring music events including Monday night open mics Tuesday night open jams and Wednesday poetry and spoken word performances. Beyond the recurring events the venue books an impressive array of touring acts ranging from regional favorites to national touring bands. The programming reflects a commitment to local artist development and cultural programming.

British Pub Atmosphere

The interior design blends candlelit tables mismatched vintage furniture and eclectic wall art creating an ambiance that feels transported from a London pub while maintaining a distinctly Chattanooga character. The space welcomes all ages and styles of people creating an inclusive and vibrant social environment.

Food and Beverage

The kitchen specializes in elevated pub fare with tavern pizza and sausage roll bites as standouts. The burger program features quality craft beef. Signature cocktails like the Pink Cadillac and Coco Picante complement a rotating selection of craft beers. The bar also offers impressive non-alcoholic and CBD options.

Outdoor Space

The back patio accessible from the interior provides one of downtown's best outdoor social spaces. The alley area is shared with neighboring businesses creating a larger gathering zone perfect for warm weather events and people-watching.

title: Gate 11 Distillery
venue_description:
Gate 11 Distillery: Historic Venue and Craft Spirits Producer

Located in Chattanooga's iconic historic Choo Choo Terminal Station built in 1909 Gate 11 Distillery combines craft spirit production with one of Chattanooga's best live music venues. Founded in 2018 the family-owned operation has earned recognition for both its award-winning spirits and its contributions to the local music scene.

Craft Spirits Production

Gate 11 distills small batches of premium vodka gin rum agave spirits and whiskey using custom-built pot column and reflux stills. The distillery emphasizes quality and innovation with each spirit craft according to specific flavor profiles and techniques. Daytime tours showcase the production process and include tastings of multiple spirits. Visitors can purchase bottles or experience cocktails at the bar.

The Music Venue

The Monday Night Blues Jam is one of Chattanooga's most beloved recurring music events. Hosted by local blues guitarist Robin Baker the house band features rotating drummers and bass players. Musicians from across the region gather to perform classic blues covers and improvisations creating an authentic blues club experience. The event draws both musicians seeking to sit in and audiences wanting quality live blues music.

Venue Layout and Atmosphere

The venue features both indoor and outdoor seating areas with views of the historic Choo Choo engine and Glenn Miller Gardens. The indoor bar provides intimate settings for conversation while the outdoor courtyard offers larger gathering spaces. Multiple bars and seating options accommodate various group sizes and preferences. The historic terminal setting with its architectural character creates an atmosphere unlike any other Chattanooga venue.

Special Events and Programming

Beyond the Monday blues jam Gate 11 hosts various special performances drag shows comedy events and seasonal celebrations. The space is available for private events and corporate gatherings. Cocktail classes led by expert mixologists teach guests how to craft professional-quality drinks.

Getting There

Gate 11 is located within the Chattanooga Choo Choo Terminal with convenient paid parking available. The historic train station setting is worth experiencing for the venue alone.

title: Songbirds Foundation
venue_description:
Songbirds Foundation: Music Museum and Live Venue

Songbirds Foundation moved to its current Southside location in April 2024 becoming Chattanooga's premier music venue and museum dedicated to preserving guitar history and supporting emerging artists. Originally founded in 2017 the nonprofit has grown to become a vital cultural institution serving hundreds of youth and thousands of live event attendees annually.

The Guitar Museum

Songbirds maintains a world-class collection of more than 40 rare and vintage guitars on permanent display including two Les Paul Goldtop prototypes and a Fender Acoustasonic previously owned by Dolly Parton. The collection also features vintage effects pedals amplifiers and music memorabilia. Interactive audio and video exhibits provide educational context and inspiration. The museum is open during all venue events and is accessible to all ages.

Live Music Programming

The twice-monthly open mic series hosted by James Snider of Fresh Mind welcomes musicians of all skill levels and genres. Limited to 10 performers with first-come-first-served sign-ups the intimate format creates a supportive community environment. The venue also hosts rock bands alt-metal groups cover bands and student performances. All performances occur in a professionally-designed concert hall with excellent acoustics. Happy hour pricing on beer and wine from 6-7 PM on open mic nights encourages community participation and discovery.

Educational Programs

Songbirds offers guitar lessons for beginners and advanced players songwriting workshops music production training and music therapy sessions. The Write to Rock program provides free guitar lessons and music experiences to elementary school students across the South. All proceeds from the venue support educational programming and artist development.

Venue Features

The space includes a 220-person capacity concert hall with a custom-built oak and ash stage providing excellent sightlines and professional sound. A full commercial kitchen and two bars provide food and beverage service. An outdoor patio expands the gathering space. The venue is available for private events corporate functions and special celebrations.

Mission and Values

Songbirds is built on the philosophy that music is transformative and that access to music education and performance opportunities should be available to all regardless of background or financial status.

title: Wanderlinger Brewing Company
venue_description:
Wanderlinger Brewing Company: Craft Brewery and Community Venue

Located in historic downtown Chattanooga near the Choo Choo Wanderlinger Brewing Company is an independently owned and operated craft brewery that has become a cultural hub for live music food and art. The space embodies a philosophy of connection where people gather to experience quality beer food and live entertainment.

Craft Beer Program

Wanderlinger produces award-winning craft beers including Stout of Tune which earned a bronze medal at the World Beer Cup 2022. The rotating tap selection includes house brews and carefully curated guest selections. The tap list emphasizes quality and diversity with options ranging from traditional European styles to experimental local innovations.

Food and Kitchen

Chef Carolyn leads the kitchen offering scratch-made cuisine featuring comfort-forward favorites and seasonal specials. Standout items include the house-brined Reuben sandwich rotating soups and chowders and a build-your-own grilled cheese program. The menu emphasizes quality local ingredients and bold flavors that pair perfectly with craft beer.

Live Music Programming

Wanderlinger hosts diverse music programming throughout the week. Monday nights feature comedy open mic providing local comedians a stage to test material. Tuesday nights are dedicated to poetry and spoken word performances creating space for literary artists. Thursday afternoons showcase bluegrass music celebrating this essential American tradition. Thursday nights host WanderJam an open mic featuring available house drums making it ideal for drummers and percussionists. Weekends feature touring bands and established local acts. The intimate stage provides excellent sightlines and professional sound reinforcement.

Community and Atmosphere

The venue is intentionally designed to feel welcoming and accessible. It is family-friendly until 9 PM and pet-friendly on the patio. Board games and card games are available for entertainment. The staff creates a genuine sense of hospitality making both regulars and newcomers feel at home. The venue emphasizes inclusivity and community over spectacle.

Location and Logistics

Located at 1208 King Street near the Choo Choo Wanderlinger shares parking with surrounding businesses. The historic downtown location places it within walking distance of other cultural attractions and dining options. Both street and garage parking options are available nearby.

title: JJ's Bohemia
venue_description:
JJ's Bohemia: Chattanooga's Eclectic Music and Comedy Venue

Operating since 2006 JJ's Bohemia has established itself as Chattanooga's premier destination for experimental diverse and boundary-pushing live entertainment. The venue is beloved by local musicians artists and creative types for its authentic character inclusive policies and adventurous programming.

Music Programming

JJ's books an extraordinarily eclectic range of live music spanning genres from rock and punk to hip-hop electronic psychedelic soul R and B and experimental music. The programming reflects a commitment to local artist development and discovery. Touring acts from around the country regularly perform here. The intimate 150-person capacity creates an optimal setting for direct artist-audience connection. Shows generally begin at 10 PM with band load-in from 8-9:30 PM. All performers receive 50 percent off drinks.

Comedy Programming

Every Thursday night features free comedy open mic where local stand-up comedians perform and test new material. The casual atmosphere encourages both established comedians and newcomers to take the stage. Wednesday nights often feature alternative comedy and performance art.

The Venue Experience

JJ's is a true dive bar in the best sense of the term. The interior features authentic character with walls covered in local art and music posters. The smoke-friendly policy and incredibly inclusive door policy create an environment where all feel welcome regardless of appearance or background. A back patio shared with neighboring businesses Bitter Alibi provides outdoor space for cooling off or additional socializing. Multiple bar areas and standing room allow for both intimate gatherings and larger events.

Technical Capabilities

The venue provides PA system moderate amount of microphones and cables for bands. The space accommodates small and large ensembles with flexible staging options. Professional sound and lighting support quality live performance.

Cultural Significance

JJ's Bohemia represents the best of Chattanooga's independent music scene. The venue has hosted emerging artists who went on to national recognition and continues to serve as an essential venue for both touring and local acts. The diverse and accepting community that has developed around JJ's makes it a truly unique cultural institution.
